title: Upgrade a Python package
summary: Update an installed Python package to its latest version.

steps.explain: Use the --upgrade flag to update the specified package to the newest available version.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package to upgrade

rollback.explain: Pip does not have a built-in downgrade command. You must manually install a specific older version if needed.

warnings: Upgrading packages can sometimes break scripts that rely on older versions.
